a522e2043e8f8cddd2dc7f4f8a6699cdb4d30833.summary: Malpedia family page for Imminent Monitor RAT, a commodity remote access tool that MITRE says was offered for sale from 2012 until 2019, when an operation took down its infrastructure. Cracked versions remain in circulation. The page lists APT-C-36 as an actor and cites references from 2016 to 2022, including 360 Threat Intelligence and Trend Micro reports on APT-C-36 activity against Colombian government institutions and South American entities. The page notes there is no Yara signature yet.
